approved: Moved the Insurance Contracts Amendment Bill 2013, proposing changes to electronic notices, consumer disclosure duties, life insurance remedies, third-party cover and exempt contracts to streamline the Insurance Contracts Act 1984 while maintaining consumer protections.

Said the coalition supported the Insurance Contracts Amendment Bill, which implements recommendations from a Howard government review of the Insurance Contracts Act, and outlined the bill's seven schedules covering the duty of good faith, ASIC's powers, electronic communication of notices, and remedies for bundled and life insurance contracts.

Supported the Insurance Contracts Amendment Bill, said Australia's insurance industry collects about $35 billion in gross premiums annually, and announced $10 million for Ipswich City Council flood mitigation projects following repeated flooding in his Blair electorate.

Thanked opposition members for their support of the Insurance Contracts Amendment Bill, and summarised its seven schedules, including making failure to meet the duty of utmost good faith a breach of the act, giving ASIC power to intervene in proceedings, and permitting electronic delivery of insurance notices.

The coalition supported the Insurance Contracts Amendment Bill 2013, which implements recommendations from the 2004 Howard government review of the Insurance Contracts Act 1984, covering seven schedules on scope, electronic communications, ASIC powers, disclosure, life insurance remedies, and third parties.
